full_name: Cora Dvorkin | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Physical Sciences Shutzer Assistant Professor Harvard University
bio: Cora Dvorkin’s research focuses on “data-driven” cosmology: predictions from fundamental physics that can be tested with cosmological data. Her research interests span questions related to inflation, dark matter, dark energy, and neutrinos.
